_doc: Paladin skill definitions (spec #308, one region per ticket): P4 #312 appends rush_paladin, P5 #313 blast and monster_magnet_paladin, P6 #314 charged_blow, P7 #315 and P8 #316 the four Charges and heavens_hammer. Power Strike and Slash Blast are defined by skills/hero.json and are never repeated here (a duplicate key across files is a load error, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Until a key is defined here it is inert: never offered or learned.

blast._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1221009 (a single `damage` field, 170 to 550%, so one line and one target; the `blast` body action and its 840 ms (540 + 300 ms) timing; the 14-frame cast effect and the 3-frame hit, both keyed by the element art index 0/1/2/3/5; the five Use sounds). Tier C: 2.0 s cooldown (the balance pass owns it), weapon_reach targeting (the nearest mob in the held weapon's swing, as Power Strike), 0.84 s action hold, art index 0 (no Charge) until P7 picks the running Charge's node, the five sounds played in order by cast number (SkillBook.use_sound, no RNG), the rarity bonuses (Mastery, Booster, Final Attack). Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.60. The screenshot `capture_delay` 0.72 s samples the thrust frame and the slash.
blast.name: Blast
blast.desc: A single devastating blow to the nearest monster within your weapon's reach.

text.desc: Deliver one huge blow to the nearest monster within your weapon's reach.

monster_magnet_paladin._rarity: Tier C: as Hero's Magnet (#303): Rare reach x1.2 (the `range` modifier: a range_around cast reads `range`), Epic Bigger Grab +2 targets, Unique Booster cooldown x0.75, Legendary Booster plus +2 targets (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter).
monster_magnet_paladin._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1221001 range 200 to 400 px, prop (pull chance 48 to 95 %), mobCount 6, the 18-frame effect and the Use sound (a UOL to Hero's 1121001); identical to Hero's 1121001 level by level (P1 #309). Tier C: a copy of Hero's `monster_magnet` under its own key (a skill key is unique across files): no damage, the shared `pull` block (7.35), the alert2 action (the node names none), the three-mob admission gate (`cast.min_targets`), the 0.6 s action hold, the 10 s cooldown (spec #308; Hero's own 4 s is tuned on Hero's runs by #346 and is not inherited), and the rarity bonuses. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.60. The screenshot `capture_delay` 0.35 s samples the horseshoe.
monster_magnet_paladin.name: Monster Magnet
monster_magnet_paladin.desc: Drags the monsters around you toward you.

text.desc: Drag distant monsters toward you, into reach of your other skills. Needs 3 monsters in range.
